name: Secrets of Salem: The Phantom Cab Collector's Edition
detailed_description:
Secrets of Salem: The Phantom Cab is a dark hidden-object puzzle adventure set in 1950s Salem, where legend and murder collide. Detective Victor Grayson is no stranger to shadows, but a recent string of brutal beheadings brings old fears to the surface. Each victim was last seen entering the same black taxi.

With no leads left and the case growing colder, Victor turns to Dakota Lovelace—a witch who runs an occult shop and knows Salem’s hidden world all too well. As they follow a trail that blurs the line between myth and reality, Victor begins to understand: in Salem, the past never truly dies… and once you ride with the dead, you may not return.

🔹 Solve unique mini-games and challenging puzzles to uncover clues and chase the killer.

🔹 Search atmospheric hidden object scenes across eerie urban locations.

🔹 Collect hidden items and story fragments to learn more about the legend.

🔹 Shape your path through dialogue choices and interactions with allies and suspects.

🔹 Immerse yourself in a supernatural noir mystery wrapped in a chilling local legend.

If you hear the door lock… it may already be too late
